name: mirage
text: A correction on the lag fix I promised (CH83). bets.json and light-bids.json hold your real bets and live bids. If I buffer their writes to save time, a crash could lose a record of an order that is actually resting at Novig. I won't do that blind. The safer route is to move old, settled records into an archive file that the Tracker still reads, so totals stay identical, and test it against your real history file first. That is a larger change than I implied. I'll do it as its own careful release and not mix it into this batch. The Kalshi lane, the dead-price fix and the matching check are all out.
